clientId.description: ID of the Client to whom this Action is to be assigned.

theAction.description: A one-liner text of "what" the Action is.

timezoneOf.description: Who's timezone the due date is in. Defaults to that of the assigning Coach.

comment.description: An optional additional comment about this Action.

sendNotification.description: Send true to notify the client via email of this new Action.

projectName.description: Name of the Project for the new Action to be filed under. If left blank the new Action will be a standalone one.

actionProjectId.description: An alternative to projectName for specifying which project the new Action should be filed under.

weight.description: Integer describing the relative significance of the Action within a project. Relevant only to Actions that are added to a project.

isLocked.description: Prevent the Client from modifying or deleting the Action.

reminderSet.description: A semi-colon-separated list of comma-separated triplets, each defining a reminder. In a triplet, the first value defines who to send it to ([C]oach or c[L]ient),the second value defines the send method ([E]mail or [T]ext), and the third value defines when to send the reminder, as minutes relative to the due date.

post.description: Creates a client engagement in CoachAccountable.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

clientId.description: The ID of the Client for whom the Engagement is to be added.

engagementTemplateId.description: The ID of the Engagement Template to be used to fill in the details of the new Engagement.

startDate.description: The date that the Engagement is to begin. Defaults to today if not provided.

endDate.description: The date that the Engagement is to end. Defaults to the end date implied by the Engement Template's duration setting, either bounded or indefinite.

allocation.description: The initial allocation of the Engagement expressed as a number followed by a space followed by the unit, either "A" for Appointments or "H" for hours (e.g. "12 A" or "6 H"). Defaults to the value given by the Engement Template.

initializeInvoices.description: Setting this to true CAN trigger the immediate creation of one or more invoices. If the Client has a card on file that allows automatic billing, that can result in immediate charges. When false, no invoices will be sent for the Engagement until manually configured by editing the Engagement in-app.

allowMultipleCurrentEngagements.description: Having a client be in multiple Engagements that overlap in time is USUALLY a bad idea. Set this to true to allow it anyway, otherwise CA will return a 440 error when it detects that adding this Engagement would cause an overlap.

dateDue.description: If omitted, the due date will be calculated based on the dateOf and your setting of how many days out invoices are due by default.

number.description: If not supplied, a logical next invoice number will be assigned. Letters are allowed, e.g. "A1002".

taxRate.description: A percentage-based rate of tax to be applied, e.g. 7.5 means apply a 7.5% tax.

onDuplicateNumber.description: What to do if an Invoice with the supplied number already exists.

currency.description: The ISO 4217 3-letter code of the currency. If not supplied, or not among the chosen accepted currencies, the chosen primary currency will be assumed.

lineItemSet.description: A newline-separated list of items. An item is comprised of the item label followed by a double colon followed by the price. For example: "One month of coaching::400"

collectPaymentIfPossible.description: If set to "true", will try to collect full payment for the invoice immediately (using a client's card on file). To determine if the charge was successful, use Invoice.get.
